lines.zh: 我踩着林间的落叶，一步一个响。
lines.en: Dry leaves crack under each step.
My shoulders are too wide; the trees must yield.
My arms hang past my knees.

lines.zh: 我走着，气从背上冒出来。
lines.en: I walk, steam rising from my back.
One stomp, and the earth sinks.

lines.zh: 腰间挂着海水泡过的布。
lines.en: A sea-soaked rag hangs at my waist.
Every few steps I shake my head.

lines.zh: 我走的路，草都压成一片。
lines.en: The grass is flattened where I pass.
I head toward the village.
I drag my steps like surf.
Standing, my chest heaving.
I sniff the wind.
Seawater runs between my teeth.
This forest is too quiet.
I lift a hand and study my claws.
I did not always look like this.
An old wound on my shoulder reopened.

lines.zh: 鼻子一喷，地上的叶全翻了。
lines.en: One snort and every leaf on the ground flips over.
Standing, the ground trembles faintly.

lines.zh: 头顶有一只鸟，我不去看。
lines.en: A bird above. I ignore it.
I listen to a distant bell.
My palms are slick.

lines.zh: 太阳偏西，我的影子盖住整条路。
lines.en: The sun slides west and my shadow swallows the whole road.
I grit my teeth.

lines.zh: 我的肩甲被海嗣顶穿了。
lines.en: The seaborn split my shoulder plate.
I wait for night.
You are shorter than one tree.

lines.zh: 你身上的肉味，比海水还冲。
lines.en: The raw meat on you cuts through the salt air.
Halt. Stop running.
Do you still know my face?
The sea gave me this body.
Which way is your village?

lines.zh: 把你手里那点东西放到地上。
lines.en: Put down that little thing in your hands.
One punch would break this tree.
You back away. Good.

lines.zh: 说，把话说完，我还没动手。
lines.en: Talk, finish what you're saying — I haven't moved yet.

lines.zh: 我不止杀生的，也吃熟的。
lines.en: I kill more than I eat.

lines.zh: 别眨眼，你的眼珠已经在打颤。
lines.en: Don't blink — your eyes are already shivering.
That scraped the hide.
I roar and take half a step back.
Blood runs down mixed with seawater.
The pain reddens my eyes.
I do not care about the wound.
You landed it. I still stand.
A strip of flesh is gone from my shoulder.

lines.zh: 挨了这一下，肚子叫得更凶。
lines.en: That blow only makes my belly roar louder.
That makes me want you dead more.
I wipe the blood off my face.
That smells of gold.
Hand it over. Be quick.

lines.zh: 管它生熟，能咽下去就行。
lines.en: Raw or cooked, as long as it goes down.
That whole sack. Give it here.
Do you carry a golden apple?
I have been hungry for days.
Do not cover it. I can see.
This is the price of your life.
More. I do not mind more.
Bring out what you hid too.
You hit me like a tree stump.
Get back. I am walking through.
My leg is thicker than your waist.
You were thrown right off.
That was not enough force.
Make way. I will not go around.

lines.zh: 退后，别踩我投下的那片黑。
lines.en: Back off — don't walk on the dark I cast.
Steady. Do not trip me up.
Keep shoving and I will throw you.
I neither dodge nor yield.
This shape is not suited to it.
The sea did not teach me that.
I only want to find food.
Do not stand so close to me.
I do not remember my past.
You should find someone else.
Right now I only want to fight.
My teeth are too long for that.
Get away. Do not provoke me.
I forgot such things long ago.
A piece of gold. Mine.
I grab it and stuff it in my mouth.
My hands are too big for small things.
This dropped, so I picked it up first.
I crushed one.
Bending is hard work for me.
I give it a lick.
Not food. Toss it.
This sack is quite heavy.
Your things, I take.

lines.zh: 树后那点动静，我看得清清楚楚。
lines.en: That rustle behind the tree — I see it perfectly well.
This time I let nothing slip.
Stand right there and hold.
You run slower than the last one.

lines.zh: 我一拳头就能砸平这面墙。
lines.en: One fist would flatten this wall.
The village is that way. Noted.
A big target. Easy to hit.
Do not count on getting away.

lines.zh: 海在叫我，可我先收拾你。
lines.en: The sea calls, but you come first.
Steam bursts from my mouth.

lines.zh: 不急，我先跨出这一只脚。
lines.en: No rush — I put this one foot forward first.
I have this whole area watched.
The snow golem counts too.
Where the villagers are, I go.

lines.zh: 隔这么远，我都闻见你身上的血。
lines.en: Even from this far off I smell the blood on you.
Good. You will do.
I have blocked the road.
Come closer. Do not dawdle.

lines.zh: 我一脚一脚碾过去，土往下陷。
lines.en: I grind forward foot by foot and the dirt sinks under me.
Your village cannot stop me.
I pull up a tree.
I throw it, and it hits.
He is shrinking into the corner.

lines.zh: 喘气一响，肩上的旧布都跟着抖。
lines.en: Every breath rattles and the old rags on my shoulder shake.
He is sweating.
Three more steps this way.
I raise a hand and block his path.
This boulder will do damage.
I smell iron on him.
He thinks I only smash.
My feet melt the snow.
I will drive him to the water.
I wait until he cannot run.

lines.zh: 五指全张开了，指缝还在流水。
lines.en: All five fingers splay wide, water still dripping between them.
This wall is not all that high.
Now is a good moment.

lines.zh: 林子外就是村子，我记住方向。
lines.en: The village lies beyond the trees. I know the way.

lines.zh: 我喘气的声音，他先听见了。
lines.en: He hears my breathing before he sees me.
Down comes a fist; earth sprays up.
I grab him and hurl him away.
My shoulder drives through the crowd.
My teeth clamp his shoulder.
A kick sends him into a tree.
That blow lands in the snow.
He blocked; his arm dropped.
I lift a foot and the ground shakes.
Claws rake from chest to belly.
I shove, and he hits the wall.
That punch will keep him down.
I shake my hand; blood flies.
Once more. Not done yet.
He is backed to the water.
I rise in the forest.
The sea remade me.
Falling branches still crackle.
Bigger than before.
Who lit a fire at the treeline?
First I scan the trees.
My belly is empty as a drum.
Steam rises off my back.
Whatever I step on shatters.
There is a village in these woods.
I shake the water off my back.
The joints in my body are cracking.
I have come. This forest is mine.

lines.zh: 潮气还没从我身上散掉。
lines.en: The damp has not left me.
The path is narrow; I cannot go fast.
I look up; the canopy closes.

lines.zh: 醒过来第一件事，是找吃的。
lines.en: The first thing after waking is to find food.
Everything here is running.

lines.zh: 我站起来，头顶的树冠歪了。
lines.en: I stand, and the canopy buckles.
Every living thing here is running.
Flame licks me. I am unafraid.

lines.zh: 坡太陡，我一路滚，压断半片林子。
lines.en: The slope was too steep; I rolled down and flattened half a grove.
Water gives me no advantage.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我推得歪了半步。
lines.en: The blast shoves me half a step off line.
An arrow in my back, like a thorn.
This blood-colored light. I do not understand it.
Hunger drains my strength.
Lightning numbs my feet.
No trees. No ground.
